lessons.title: Introduction to Animation in Unity
lessons.description: Learn how Unity brings characters and objects to life with the Animation system and the Animator component.

lessons.title: Creating Animation Clips
lessons.description: Use the Animation window to record property changes and create reusable animation clips.

lessons.title: The Animator Component & Controller
lessons.description: Attach an Animator to a GameObject, assign an Animator Controller, and understand the state machine.

lessons.title: Transitions & Parameters
lessons.description: Connect animation states with transitions and drive them using parameters like bools, triggers, and floats.

lessons.title: Blend Trees & Animation Scripting
lessons.description: Blend multiple animations smoothly and control the Animator from C# scripts for dynamic character motion.
